en: Use The Great Zucchini to turn dangerous zombies into their weakest link!
zh: 使​​用伟大的西葫芦将危险的僵尸变成他们最薄弱的环节！

en: Don't those noses look familiar? Take them out before they sniff your Sun-shrooms!
zh: 这鼻子是不是很眼熟？在它们嗅到你的阳光菇之前把它们消灭掉！

en: Chilled zombies take more damage from fire damage!
zh: 冰冷的僵尸会受到更多火焰伤害！

zh: 塔罗牌在关卡开始时会洗牌，但牌组是相同的。

en: The Vendor Bros. will ignore buffed zombies (and each other)!
zh: 供应商兄弟将忽略经过抛光的僵尸（以及彼此）！

en: A seemingly bad Card can be a blessing in disguise!
zh: 一张看似糟糕的卡，也可能因祸得福！

en: Plant a Hypno-shroom or Sun Bean in front of a Grinderhead.
zh: 在研磨头前种植魅惑菇或太阳豆。

en: Group a bunch of Zombies together before triggering a beneficial Tarot Card.
zh: 将一群僵尸聚集在一起，然后触发一张有益的塔罗牌。

en: Some Jack-in-the-Boxes are duds that explode quickly, but only summon one toy. Oops!
zh: 一些杰克盒子是会快速爆炸的哑弹，但只能召唤一个玩具。哎呀！

en: Use Potato Chips to quickly peek at the Tarot Cards at the start of the night before things get crazy.
zh: 使用脆薯片在事情变得疯狂之前在夜晚开始时快速浏览塔罗牌。

en: Mirrors have magic properties to reflect magic spells!

en: oh poor thang...
zh: 哦可怜...

en: Leave spaces in the back columns for bigger shooters.
zh: 把更强大的射手放在后排。

en: Thrown Imps tend to land in the same spots.
zh: 扔出来的小鬼往往落在相同的位置。

en: Zombies of a world can be defeated by plants of that world.
zh: 来自某个世界的僵尸可以被来自相同世界的植物击败。

en: Stop or slow early zombies to give more time to generate sun.
zh: 前期让僵尸减速或者停下来，可以给你充分的时间积累阳光。

en: Build sun production as fast and early as you can.
zh: 尽快、尽早建立起你的阳光生产体系。

en: Replace sun producers with offensive plants later in the level.
zh: 在关卡后期将阳光生产植物替换成攻击植物。

en: Back up barrier plants with short-range melee plants behind them.
zh: 备份屏障植物，后面有短程近战植物。

en: Plant sun producers early and often.
zh: 尽早、尽多地种植阳光生产植物。

en: Try for 2 columns of sun producers.
zh: 试着种植 2 排阳光生产植物。

en: Try to save sun for costlier but more powerful plants.
zh: 试着为更贵但更强的植物积攒阳光。

en: Use Plant Food on anything to make room for floating Plant Foods.
zh: 在任何东西上使用叶绿素，为漂浮的叶绿素腾出空间。

en: A plant becomes briefly invulnerable during its Plant Food effect.
zh: 处于叶绿素效果中的植物会短暂无敌。

en: Don't be afraid to plant on the right half of the lawn.
zh: 不要害怕把植物种在草坪的右半边。

en: Press the advantage.
zh: 紧握优势，乘胜追击。

en: Try insta-kills like Chili Bean or Chomper against heavily armored zombies.
zh: 尝试使用巴豆、大嘴花之类的秒杀植物对抗有强大盔甲的僵尸。

en: Boosted plants work differently, check them out!
zh: 增强植物的作用不同，检查一下！

en: Use Infi-nut's Plant Food ability to block those pesky Fishermen and their hooks!
zh: 使用不灭坚果的叶绿素能力来阻挡那些讨厌的渔民和他们的鱼钩！

en: Magnet-shroom instantly takes out All-Stars and Chair Racers.
zh: 磁铁蘑菇立即消灭全明星和椅子赛车手。

en: Use Hypno-shroom on zombies with high bite damage, health, or both!
zh: 对咬合力高、血厚，或两者兼具的僵尸使用魅惑菇！

en: Use fire plants to deal with troublesome Egg Stealers and Rock Carriers!
zh: 使用火焰植物对付麻烦的偷蛋者和运石者！

en: Use cheap, spammable plants to distract MC Zom-B's microphone spin!
zh: 使用廉价的垃圾植物来分散MC 僵-B的麦克风旋转！

en: Penny's Challenges focus on your endurance. Work out any leaks in your defense!
zh: 潘妮的挑战侧重于你的耐力。解决你防守中的任何漏洞！

en: Plant forms of fodder to block Tomb Raiser's bones.
zh: 种植饲料来阻挡盗墓者的骨头。

en: Manipulate your defense to benefit from Jurassic Marsh's tar.
zh: 操纵你的防御，从恐龙危机的焦油中受益。

en: Certain jams can speed up or slow down zombies!
zh: 某些堵塞可以加速或减慢僵尸！

en: Want to replay Epic Quest levels? Visit Travel Log's Tourist Trap!
zh: 想重玩史诗任务关卡吗？参观旅行日志的游客陷阱！

en: Vine plants share space with other plants, making them a great use for extra sun!
zh: 藤本植物与其他植物共享空间，使它们非常适合获得额外的阳光！

en: Thymed Events usually appear during special holiday occassions!
zh: 限时活动通常会在特殊节日期间出现！

en: Try out different plants, you just might find a new favorite!
zh: 尝试不同的植物，说不定你会发现新的最爱！

en: Take advantage of minecarts to move expensive plants.
zh: 利用矿车移动昂贵的植物。

en: Keep exploring! Progressing through Adventure will unlock Epic Quests!
zh: 继续探索！通过冒险取得进展将解锁史诗任务！

en: Repairimps working overtime? Try Boingsetta!
zh: 修理工加班？尝试一品红！

en: Plant defensive plants like Wall-nut on sewers!
zh: 在下水道上种植坚果墙等防御植物！

en: You never know what Portals can contain, so prepare for the worst!
zh: 你永远不知道传送门会包含什么，所以要做好最坏的打算！

en: Place cheap plants in front of charging All-Stars to stop them!
zh: 在冲锋的全明星面前放置廉价植物来阻止他们！

en: Bought an Epic Realm? Check it out in the Travel Log's Tourist Trap!
zh: 买了史诗境界？去旅行日志的游客陷阱里看看吧！

en: Constructing new roads...
zh: 修建新道路...

en: Inflating weasels...
zh: 充气黄鼠狼...

en: Use the cannon powerup as much as you feel like it — it's free, after all!
zh: 随心所欲地使用加农炮能量——毕竟它是免费的！

en: Filling out the Almanac? Try out Inzanity!
zh: 填写年鉴？尝试一下疯狂吧！

en: Check our Discord for update announcements!
zh: 查看我们的 Discord 以获取更新公告！

en: Look up to the sky...
zh: 仰望天空...

en: Puffapple can deflect more projectiles when given Plant Food!
zh: Puffapple 给予叶绿素后可以偏转更多射弹！

en: Meteor Flower and Tar make for a deadly combo!
zh: 流星花和焦油构成致命的组合！

en: Check out the Sandbox in Travel Log's Tourist Trap to test plants freely!
zh: 查看《旅行日志》游客陷阱中的沙箱，自由测试植物！

en: Commando Zombie alternates between straight and lobbed shots.
zh: 突击队僵尸在直射和吊射之间交替。

en: Draftodil has decreased effectivity on Assault Airspace Zombies!
zh: 通风水仙降低了攻击空域僵尸的效率！

en: Beware- grounded projectiles fall into the sky in Assault Airspace!
zh: 小心 - 落地炮弹落入侵袭空域的天空！

en: You can't make new Clouds, so make the most of what the sky gives.
zh: 你无法制造新的云，所以天空给什么就好好用什么。

en: Saucer Squash can abduct Bulls and smaller zombies regardless of health!
zh: 飞碟瓜可以绑架公牛和较小的僵尸，无论血量如何！

en: The Rift houses various zombies of odd appearance AND ability!
zh: 裂谷里住着各种外表和能力都奇怪的僵尸！

en: The Rift can contain just about ANY zombie!
zh: 裂缝几乎可以容纳任何僵尸！

zh: 正在加载资源
